quotes.text: "Great software is opinionated" is something I've been saying for years... And yet I have to say it so often to the teams I've worked with or managed.
quotes.author: simonbarker87
quotes.source: Hacker News — Someone behind the software
quotes.extraction_note: Core insight: opinionated software needs opinionated humans, and that's not an obvious point to teams. Trimmed the self-effacing preamble.
